# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m151 and Graphite GPU backends**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 introduces Graphite GPU backend bindings and several performance improvements. This release adds Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn Graphite GPU backend bindings, async pixel-read APIs for SKImage and SKSurface, the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and FreeType font support on Nano Server. It also ships several performance improvements for hot managed paths.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m151 upstream stability fixes** — Two upstream sync merges bring chrome/m151 bug fixes into the bundled engine, keeping the renderer in line with the latest stable upstream. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — The new next-generation Skia Graphite renderer is now accessible from SkiaSharp. Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn (WebGPU) backend contexts and recorders are exposed, letting consumers opt into the Graphite path alongside the existing Ganesh backends. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async RequestReadPixels on SKImage and SKSurface** — A new backend-neutral async pixel-read API lets GPU-backed images and surfaces deliver pixels to a callback without blocking the GPU thread. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path** — When creating a raster SKImage failed, the unmanaged pixel buffer was not freed. The leak is now plugged. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Performance: SKData.SaveTo avoids a double buffer copy** — The save path now writes directly to the destination stream instead of staging through an intermediate buffer, halving memory traffic for large blobs. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **Performance: GetEncodedText and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms hot paths** — The null-terminated encoded-text path avoids an intermediate string allocation, and the uniform-lookup map is pre-sized to the known count, cutting allocations on repeated calls. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — Nano Server lacks the GDI font stack; the native build now links FreeType so font rendering works on that container target. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and Vulkan tests on Android and Linux** — A new integration package wires SkiaSharp’s Vulkan backend to the Silk.NET Vulkan bindings. Vulkan tests now also run on Android and Linux CI legs via a software ICD. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Containerized test coverage: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — New Docker-based CI legs verify SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server container targets. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **.slnx solution format and Windows SDK unpinned** — All solution files are converted to the new `.slnx` format, and the Windows SDK version is no longer pinned by default so consumers pick up the SDK present in their environment. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528), [#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588))
